description: Record what you built in one call, at the end of a piece of work: its passing verification, its change event and the findings it answered, its files' checksums, and the work marked built. It serves job 4 of reflow2's five, whether what was built meets what was asked. Steps, in order, each with its own receipt: `verification` (recorded as passing); `change` (with `answers`, which draws INVALIDATES); `files` (each file registered if it is not yet, its checksum accepted against the change, and a test file joined to the verification it `runs`); `built` (each one's status set to realized, or a dec: joined to them; `replace` revises its words). ALL OR NOTHING: a refused step names itself, and nothing is written. The tools it runs (add_verification, add_change_event, set_artifact_checksums, set_capability_status, replace_text) stay served. Ask for it to record what you built.

AffectedNodeReq.description: One node an event changed, for `add_change_event`'s `affected` list.

node_type.description:
The changed node's type (e.g. `Requirement`, `Artifact`).
Optional since 2026-09-06: resolved from the id when omitted (the id
prefix names the type); an id held by more than one type is REFUSED, never
guessed — pass it then.

AnswerReq.description: One finding a change answered, for `add_change_event`'s `answers` list.

finding_id.description: The finding's id: a Verification or a TemporalFact.

finding_type.description: Its type, resolved from the id when omitted.

note.description:
How it answers it, when that needs saying: "partly: the cold path is
still slow".

BuiltChangeReq.description: Step 2: the change, as add_change_event takes it.

affected.description:
The nodes it changed (a CHANGED edge to each). The files in step 3
are joined to it by their acceptance and need not be listed here.

answers.description: The findings it answered (INVALIDATES to each), or `[]` for none.

change_type.description:
WHY it changed: `new_feature`, `defect_fix` and the rest
add_change_event takes.

commits.description: The commits it was made in, comma-separated.

detected_at.description: When it landed, as a plain date. Dates each answer and acceptance too.

name.description: A short name, for a new change.

stands_in_for.description: What the proper fix would be; required with `contained_symptom`.

subject.description:
`system` (the thing changed) or `record` (only the design's knowledge
of it did). Absent means nobody said.

BuiltFileReq.description: Step 3: one file the work changed.

artifact_id.description:
The Artifact's id (`art:…`). One not yet registered is registered
first, and then needs `name`.

artifact_type.description: What kind of file, to register a new one.

checksum.description:
Its new checksum, accepted on this call's change. Omitted, a server
that can read the file measures it.

location.description: Where it lives, to register a new file.

name.description: A name, to register a new file.

runs.description:
The Verification this file RUNS (IMPLEMENTS): a test file names the
check it is.

id.description: A Capability (`cap:…`), or a Decision (`dec:…`) the work carried out.

replace.description: Revise its words to say it is built, as replace_text does.

old.description: The exact text to replace; omitted, `new` is appended.

built.description: Step 4: the capabilities and decisions now built.

change.description: Step 2: the change, with `answers` naming the findings it closed.

echo.description: What the reply carries. `receipt` (the default) names the node, echoes each stored value of at most 200 characters, gives longer ones by size, and names the snapshot that keeps anything a revise replaced. `node` returns the whole stored node and every prior value.

files.description:
Step 3: the files the work changed, each registered if new and its
checksum accepted on the change.

verification.description: Step 1: the check that passed. Omit it for work no check covers.

id.description:
The Verification's id (`ver:…`). An existing check is revised; a new
one needs `name`.

last_run_at.description: When it ran and passed, as a plain date.

method.description: HOW it was checked, as add_verification takes it.

name.description: A short name, for a new check.

verifies.description:
What it checks: the ids of the Capabilities, Components, Requirements
or Artifacts it VERIFIES.

name: record_the_build
title: Record the Build
